condition: Air Greenland operated its final commercial fixed-wing Narsarsuaq flight on 15 Apr 2026. Greenland Airports tariff classification changes Narsarsuaq from airport to HELIPORT effective 16 Apr 2026. Historic paved runway retained in technical group; no automatic fixed-wing route activation, even in no-war scenario.

Air Greenland states every booked passenger/transit at Pituffik Space Base must have ministry-issued entry/transit permission. Settlement scheduled flights and cargo exist but do NOT confer ordinary public airport access; check base-specific freight and aircraft permits.

Danish aviation authority April 16 2026 approved Qaqortoq opening with temporary safety conditions; initial schedule for Air Greenland only and regulator-imposed movement limits. Conditions can change after commissioning; verify current approval before treating as open to additional airline operators or arbitrary cargo aircraft.
